address: ZF, 27 Waterloo Place Edinburgh, United Kingdom,EH1 3BQ
bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea aboard the Vintage Red Bistro Bus as you are whisked around the beautiful city of Edinburgh.  A refreshingly quirky yet sophisticated way to sight-see!  Enjoy a delicious selection of home-made cakes, pastries and sandwiches- all made with the finest of local ingredients. A choice of loose leaf tea are served in specially commissioned chinaware is the perfect accompaniment to such a mouth-watering selection.
